readerCopy.body: Something normally censored can become easier to express through art, writing, fantasy, humor, or an unusually unguarded conversation. When Neptune trines Lilith, imagination and autonomy reinforce each other, loosening the rules around what is acceptable to admit without requiring every private thought to become a public declaration. Repetition can reveal the desire before a decision has been made about what to do with it. Inspiration becomes useful when it shows what keeps asking for a place in the story.
